"Mirrored" networking makes WSL use the Windows network adapters directly: the traceroute no longer shows the extra hop of WSL's internal NAT and is more accurate.

A command window will open and run, as YOUR user ({0}):

    wsl --install -d Ubuntu-24.04

If the WSL component is not active yet, Windows will ask for administrator confirmation for that part only, and a PC restart may be needed (then run this command again).

At the end Ubuntu asks you to create a Linux user: complete that step, close the window and press "Refresh" in this program.

IMPORTANT: do not install Ubuntu with a different administrator account, otherwise the distribution is registered for that account and is not visible here.
